pages.text: At sunset, the sheep went into the pen. The gate had to close firmly after the last one.
Today, Pipo wanted to be gatekeeper. He stood right beside the gate.
Mr. Horse came over. "Closing quickly is best! Dawdle, and sheep come back out."
While sheep were still entering, he grabbed the gate. "Now, closing!"
He yanked it shut. A sheep entering got caught in the gap. Baa—!
The sheep behind it rushed backward. The space before the pen emptied.
Mr. Horse gently freed the trapped sheep. "Oh... I will bring them back." His voice grew quiet.
From far away, he herded the sheep back. Pipo held the gate and waited quietly.
The last sheep's tail slipped inside. Pipo closed the gate gently. Click.
The pen soon grew quiet. Sheep lay side by side. Mr. Horse tiptoed away. "Shh, I am going first."
